retrievalProfile.description: A centered musician portrait surrounded by a dense foreground and background of glowing pillar candles, utilizing a warm sepia-toned palette and elegant mixed-serif typography.
triggerTerms: soft glow studio photography with instrument
excludeWhen: minimalist flat vector styles are needed
outdoor natural light settings are required

recipe.visualDefinition: A central figure sits cross-legged holding a vertical woodwind instrument, framed by a sea of lit pillar candles of varying heights. The lighting is dominated by the warm, yellow-orange glow of the flames, creating a soft, intimate atmosphere against a neutral, warm-grey studio background.
coreVisualRelationships: Central subject framed by a dense field of candles in the lower third
Large-scale display text overlapping the subject's head
Warm yellow candle light contrasting with dark clothing
Symmetrical balance with the subject as the vertical axis
coreInvariants: Warm, monochromatic-leaning color temperature dominated by candle glow
Shallow depth of field with blurred candles in the immediate foreground
Subject holding a vertical musical instrument centrally

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, medium-full shot of a seated figure occupying the middle two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The musician's face and the vertical line of the instrument.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the large top text down to the subject's face, following the instrument down to the candle field, and finally to the bottom metadata text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Neutral warm-grey space in the upper corners around the display typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm yellow and orange from candle flames and reflections.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black or dark brown of the subject's sweater.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep burgundy for the script subtitle.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the yellows/oranges; low value in the central subject; high value in the white display text.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain a warm, sepia-adjacent tonal range

letterConstructionRules: Display name uses ultra-light, wide geometric strokes
Subtitle uses a fluid, high-contrast formal script
Bottom text uses a wide-tracked, bold serif
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of ultra-modern thin sans-serif with traditional romantic script.
graphicDevices: Layered depth with text behind and in front of subject elements

preserve: Ultra-thin weight of the top text
Wide tracking of the bottom text
avoid: Heavy bold fonts for the main name

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, wide, and thin display style
Captures the elegant, high-contrast script feel

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a musician with long curly hair, wearing a black sweater, sitting cross-legged and holding a saxophone. Surround the subject with dozens of lit cream-colored pillar candles of varying heights, creating a warm yellow glow. Background should be a soft, warm neutral grey.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist name in a large, ultra-thin white geometric sans-serif at the top. Add the album title in a dark burgundy formal script on the middle left. Add the description text at the bottom in a bold, wide-tracked serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the top text ultra-thin and wide?
Are there candles in both the foreground and background?
Is the overall color temperature warm and golden?
Is the subject centered and holding an instrument?

mustRedesign: Do not use existing brand logos

mustAchieve: Soft, diffused lighting from the candles

postGenerationChecks: Check that the thin white text is legible against the background
Ensure the candle flames look natural and glowing
Verify the script text has a high-contrast calligraphic feel
Confirm the subject's pose is centered and stable
recipe.reuseFormula: Warm Studio Portrait + Candle Field + Mixed Serif/Script Typography
